newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast to buy 12 Jetstream aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast to buy 12 Jetstream aircraft.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines said Wednesday it signed an agreement in principle with European aircraft manufacturer Aero International (Regional) to buy 12 29-passenger Jetstream 41 aircraft.
Delivery of the 12 aircraft begins in January and will be completed in mid-1999, Atlantic Coast said.
Atlantic Coast, which operates as United Express in the Eastern United States, said it currrently operates 28 J-41s.
The company operates its hub at Washington Dulles International Airport and serves 38 cities in 17 states with non-stop service.
A purchase price was not provided. The agreement includes favorable third party aircraft financing alternatives and facilitates refinancing of existing J-41s, Atlantic Coast said.
Aero International (Regional) is owned by French group Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc and Italy's Alenia, a unit of state-controlled Finmeccanica SpA.
